d:
・Lazy Big Sister
A female college student attending a university one station away
. She lives at home, but her parents are on a business trip overseas, so she lives with her younger sister.
She leaves all the housework to her younger sister and spends all her free time playing games. She
nags at her, but she loves her younger sister who takes care of her in some way or another.

・Responsible Little Sister (not featured this time)
A female high school student attending a nearby high school.
She is a reliable little sister who does all the housework in place of her useless older sister.
She nags at her
older sister who is always rolling around on the sofa and not working, but she doesn't mind taking care of her.

・Intruders,
scum
